holdoutValidation.timing: Set after seeing held-out results and before any character trace was judged.

standingSpeaker.rule: In the talk class, every gated band fitted per clip from the talk window clips becomes REPORT. Those windows and their activity floors come from talk reference performers who locomote. The values are still measured and printed; the fitted bounds stay in the file.
standingSpeaker.reason: talk reference performers locomote; floors are not valid for a standing speaker
standingSpeaker.source: User decision, 2026-11-11: "Speech gate: Rules now, reference later (Recommended)".

clearOfNeutral.rule: min over every emotion other than neutral of its separation from neutral and from placebo >= 2; neutral against placebo excluded
clearOfNeutral.reason: neutral has no posture, so neutral against placebo cannot separate; emotion.minSeparationFromNeutral gates instead
clearOfNeutral.source: User decision, 2026-11-11: "Emotion gate: Clear of neutral (Recommended)". Threshold 2 is the declared bar of emotion.minSeparation, not fitted from human data.

sidePooling.rule: A fitted metric that names a left or right bone or region and has a fitted mirror is fitted once from both sides pooled, under the unchanged fitting and held-out rules; the one band applies to both ids, and held-out units are judged on both sides against it. Each left or right bone activity floor and the armL/armR move speed are likewise fitted once from both sides pooled under their unchanged rules and applied to both sides.
sidePooling.source: User decision, 2026-11-11: "Arm bands: Gate v2, pooled sides (Recommended)".
sidePooling.timing: Decided after a tuned character failed left-side arm metrics only; no character data entered the fit.

refusals.name: non-upright
refusals.detail: 30/454 scored frames have horizontal hips forward length < 0.5

longIdleCoverage.detail: The fixed manifest does not contain four idle ranges of at least 20 s; no clips added or ranges extended.

deskHead.basis: context only, two seated desk sessions

limits: episode bootstrap mixes dependent trials and actors
declared rules have no fitted human distribution
